title: ReviewsReviewWrittenPayload
description: Payload of `reviews.review.written` version 1: a customer reviewed a completed order once, with a thumb, tags, perhaps a note and photos. The envelope's `partner_id` is the store's Partner and its `correlation_id` follows the order. The payload carries no note text; read the review at `GET /v1/platform/reviews?order_id=`. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

number.description: The order's number, as said aloud.

partner_id.description: The store's Partner; the envelope's `partner_id` too.

customer_id.description: The customer (a user id); fetch personal data from the API when it is needed.

has_note.description: Whether a note came with it.

photos.description: How many photos came with it.

fulfilment.description: How the order reached the customer: `delivered`, `delivered_by_own_agent`, `collected`, or, since 0.28.0, `dine_in` for a settled tab's review (the tab's id is `order_id`), or, since 0.29.0, `on_site` for a completed booking.

agent_id.description: The Agent who carried a delivery or, since 0.29.0, did a booked job; `null` for a collection.

booking_id.description: Since 0.29.0, the booking a completed booking's review is about (`order_id` is the booking's order of fulfilment on site); absent or `null` on other reviews.

source.description: What it reviews: an `order`, or a `subscription` for a month, whose `order_id` is the month's last completed delivery. Absent on reviews written before step 7, which are of orders.

subscription_id.description: The subscription, on a subscription's review.

month.description: The month it reviews on the Location's clock, `YYYY-MM`, on a subscription's review.
